youtube_short.title: The Free 17% Return Hiding In Your Pay Stub
title_alternatives: 40% of Workers Are Skipping a Free 17% Return
Your Employer Is Offering Free Money — Most People Skip It
youtube_short.description: Your company hid a money machine inside your benefits portal called an ESPP — Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You set aside part of your paycheck and your employer buys you company stock at a 15% discount. Sell it the same day and you've locked in a 17.6% return before the market even opens. Most plans also have a lookback provision so you win whether the stock goes up or down. For a $60K salary contributing 10%, that's over $1,000 in free profit every year — and 40% of eligible workers never enroll. Open your HR portal today and look for ESPP in your benefits. #personalfinance #ESPP #moneytips #investingtips #workbenefits

hook_line: Your company built a free 17% return into your benefits
